build_multimodal_pages: build multimodal page representations from a docling ConversionResult with segments, cells, markdown, and document tokens
export_page_segments: export page segments with bounding boxes, labels, and text from a converted document result
export_page_cells: export page cells with normalized bounding boxes, OCR flags, and confidence scores
export_markdown: export document content as markdown text from a converted legacy document
export_document_tokens: export document content as document token format from a converted legacy document
